decision.explanation: Both D2S1 and D3S1 explicitly state that the CCSSO announced 'Tabatha Rosproy' and 'Juliana Urtubey' respectively as the '2021 National Teacher of the Year'. The prompt instructions require preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers even when they appear contradictory in the source text, as different people can be claimed to hold the same title in different documents. Both candidates C0 and C1 are directly supported by their respective source segments with the correct entity type (person) and constraint (2021).
